# Skyvern

Skyvern automates browser-based workflows with AI agents that can navigate websites, extract data, and complete tasks.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/skyvern/.

## Actions

- **Cancel Runs**: Cancel one or more active task or workflow runs in one request and report which IDs succeeded or failed.
- **Create Folder**: Create a folder for organizing Skyvern agents.
- **Delete Folder**: Delete a Skyvern folder without deleting the agents it contains.
- **Get Folder** (read-only): Get one Skyvern folder by ID, including its current agent count.
- **Get Run** (read-only): Get current status, output, errors, files, and observation links for a task or workflow run.
- **List Agents** (read-only): Search and list the latest versions of Skyvern agents available to the connected organization.
- **List Folders** (read-only): Search and list folders used to organize Skyvern agents.
- **List Runs** (read-only): Find task and workflow runs for the connected organization, with status, type, workflow, and text filters.
- **Start Browser Task**: Start an autonomous browser task that can navigate and interact with websites, including clicking and submitting forms.
- **Update Folder**: Change the title or description of an existing Skyvern folder.
